title: How you get paid
intro: Here's how your delivery money reaches you, and what to do with cash on delivery.

steps.caption: Your money, in Money
steps.vo: Open the Money tab. You see what you earned this week, today, and in the last thirty days. You're paid once delivery is confirmed.

steps.caption: Straight to your bank
steps.vo: Customers pay the delivery fee at checkout. It goes straight to your bank through our payment provider. Shopinbos never holds it. Tap Change to use a different bank.

steps.caption: Pass on cash by 6pm
steps.vo: Cash your riders collect on delivery belongs to the sellers. Pass it on by the time shown. Tap Copy, and send it to this account. We match your payment automatically.

steps.caption: Or pay each seller
steps.vo: You can also open Pay-on-delivery cash and pay each seller straight to their bank. If you handed it over another way, tap I've sent it, and they'll confirm.

outro: Pay in on time, and you'll keep getting cash on delivery jobs.
